strategy: combo_v2 2.0x long-only momentum blend (bundle v2.3_nofreeze), Alpaca paper account

reference.source: Corrected 10-yr backtest (engine_v2 next_open execution, 5bp/side TC, 600bp/yr margin), survivors-only universe — every reference number is an upper bound.

power_disclosure.note: At sigma_m ~= 15.7%, the SE of the mean monthly return is ~9.1pp at 3 months, ~6.4pp at 6 months, ~4.5pp at 12 months. This test CANNOT confirm 3.68%/mo. It can reject gross failure, calibrate real trading costs, and verify the machine matches backtest assumptions.

criteria.description: Continuous kill: live drawdown from the forward-test equity peak reaches -45% or worse.
Continuous kill-or-recost: realized slippage exceeds 25bp/side over >=3 consecutive rebalances.
Continuous operational pause: fill rate by notional below 90% on two consecutive rebalances.
Continuous operational pause: achieved-vs-target gross deviation above 15% on two consecutive rebalances.
3-month operational check: realized monthly volatility within [7%, 25%]/mo (machine matches backtest risk profile).
3-month operational check: geometric monthly return above -10%/mo (no gross failure).
3-month operational check: median slippage <= 15bp/side, measured on >= 3 rebalances.
3-month operational check: post-rebalance reconciliation green on at least 2 of the last 3 rebalances.

6-month band: cumulative log return must exceed expected - 1.28*sigma_m*sqrt(6) = 6*ln(1.0368) - 1.28*0.157*sqrt(6) ~= 0.2168 - 0.4922 = -0.2754 (about -24.1% simple). AND-ed with the regime adjustment in and_conditions: KILL fires only if the band is breached AND live - 2x SPY < -15pp AND live < 0 over the same window.
12-month SUCCESS requirement: geometric monthly return >= 1.8%/mo (pre-declared survivorship-haircut floor).
12-month SUCCESS requirement: max drawdown no worse than -45%.
12-month INCONCLUSIVE (extend 6 months): geometric monthly return in [0, 1.8)%/mo with a documented regime headwind. Upper bound 1.8 is exclusive (>= 1.8 belongs to M12-GEO).
12-month FAIL: geometric monthly return < 0 at 12 months. Any continuous kill (K1/K2) firing at any time is also FAIL.

decision_rule.SUCCESS: All four REQUIRED_FOR_SUCCESS criteria pass at 12 months -> real-money discussion.
decision_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: M12-INCONCLUSIVE holds (geo in [0, 1.8)%/mo with documented regime headwind) -> extend the test 6 months.
decision_rule.FAIL: geo < 0 at 12 months, or any kill criterion fired.

amendment_rule: Amendments only via dated amendment sections appended to PROTOCOL.md plus a re-issued protocol.json with amended=true (permanent — never reset to false) and its new sha256 recorded alongside the original. Prior sections are never rewritten. Any hash mismatch against the sha256 bound at forward_test_start permanently flags the test MODIFIED_AFTER_START.
